description: Welcome to My Skydome, a unique place in the heart of the upper Marais. This 200 m2 flat is the result of an ambitious project by an Italian architect and a Parisian decorator to create an exceptional living space. This 200 m2 apartment is the result of an ambitious project by an Italian architect and a Parisian decorator to create an exceptional living space.The glass roof covering a Parisian courtyard from 1896 is highlighted by the use of original materials such as wood and stone.
